slogan: Advancing Binary Understanding and Software Engineering with AI.
research_statement: My research focuses on large language models for binary analysis and reverse engineering, as well as AI agents for software engineering. I am interested in building systems that understand low-level code, reason about software, and solve practical engineering tasks.
